mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) during the triggered period.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% is associated with higher wage growth expectations, which elevates S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant positive deviation from the prior 60-day average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO supply index below 100 (annualized) suggests softening manufacturing capacity, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day (or 5-day) backtest shows no consistent negative returns during similar supply contraction episodes (IC > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST retail sales fall by more than 2% month-over-month, it indicates weakening consumer demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: During triggered events, 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS for three consecutive months signals persistent monetary easing, which increases equity valuation multiples and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no mean outperformance vs. prior 60-day window (IC < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3% for two consecutive months, it reflects weakening labor market strength and is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: During such episodes, 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (retail demand) above their 2021 Q4 averages for two months create a momentum effect that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 2021Q4 avg & RSAFS > 2021Q4 avg for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A cross-year (quarter-to-date) INDPRO index below 98 signals persistent supply constraints, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during such episodes are not consistently negative (IC > 0.1).
